autoCollapse.zh-CN: 是否在滚动时动态展示下一级锚点。
autoCollapse.en-US: Whether the next level of links is shown dynamically while scrolling.

getContainer.zh-CN: 指定滚动的容器，缺省为 window；返回模板 ref 的值时容器出现或替换后自动换绑。
getContainer.en-US: Returns the scrolling container, window when omitted. When it returns the value of a template ref, the listener follows the container as it appears or is replaced.

maxHeight.zh-CN: 组件的 max-height，超出时显示滚动条；style 中的 max-height 优先。
maxHeight.en-US: max-height of the component, with a scrollbar when exceeded. A max-height in style wins.

maxWidth.zh-CN: 组件的 max-width，超出时显示省略；style 中的 max-width 优先。
maxWidth.en-US: max-width of the component, truncating when exceeded. A max-width in style wins.

offsetTop.zh-CN: 滚动内容距离容器顶部达到指定偏移量时触发当前链接切换。
offsetTop.en-US: Offset from the top of the container at which the current link switches while content scrolls.

position.zh-CN: showTooltip 开启时 Tooltip 的显示位置，可选值同 Tooltip 的 position。
position.en-US: Position of the Tooltip when showTooltip is on, with the same values as the Tooltip position.

railTheme.en-US: Theme of the rail: primary, tertiary or muted.

scrollMotion.zh-CN: 点击锚点滚动时是否带动画。
scrollMotion.en-US: Whether scrolling after a click is animated.

scrollIntoViewOptions.zh-CN: 点击锚点滚动时传给 scroll-into-view-if-needed 的选项，与 scrollMotion、targetOffset 合并使用。
scrollIntoViewOptions.en-US: Options passed to scroll-into-view-if-needed when a link is clicked, combined with scrollMotion and targetOffset.

showTooltip.zh-CN: 文字缩略时是否显示 Tooltip 及相关配置：type 为浮层组件，支持 tooltip（默认）和 popover，opts 为传给浮层组件的属性。
showTooltip.en-US: Whether a Tooltip shows when the text is truncated, with its options: type is the popup component, tooltip (default) or popover, and opts are passed to it.

size.en-US: Size of the anchor: small or default.

targetOffset.zh-CN: 锚点滚动结束时，目标距离容器顶部的偏移量。
targetOffset.en-US: Distance between the target and the top of the container when scrolling ends.

change.zh-CN: 高亮的锚点改变时触发，参数为当前锚点与上一个锚点。
change.en-US: Emitted when the highlighted link changes, with the current and the previous link.

click.zh-CN: 点击锚点或在锚点上按 Enter 时触发，参数为原生 MouseEvent 或 KeyboardEvent 与当前锚点；声明为组件事件后，@click 不再作为根元素的原生点击监听。
click.en-US: Emitted when a link is clicked or activated with Enter, with the native MouseEvent or KeyboardEvent and the current link. As a component event, @click no longer listens for native clicks on the root element.

default.zh-CN: 由 Anchor.Link 组成的子项。

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用，禁用后不响应点击跳转。
disabled.en-US: Whether the link is disabled and ignores clicks.

href.zh-CN: 跳转的目标，以 # 开头时按元素 id 查找，其余按 CSS 选择器查找。
href.en-US: Target of the link. A value starting with # is looked up by element id, anything else as a CSS selector.

title.zh-CN: 纯文本标题；未开启 showTooltip 时同时作为原生 title，提供 title 插槽时以插槽为准。
title.en-US: Plain-text title, also the native title when showTooltip is off. The title slot wins when it is provided.

default.en-US: Nested Anchor.Link of the next level.

title.zh-CN: 节点形式的标题，优先于 title 属性。
title.en-US: Title as nodes. Takes precedence over the title prop.
